short_description: Air raid alerts for regions of Ukraine and cities of Israel, on your BUSY Bar.
description:
## How to use

In the app's settings, choose up to three regions — Kyiv, any of 23 Ukrainian regions, or all of Israel — and up to three of 31 Israeli cities.

## What you see

- No alert: NO ALERTS in green.
- An alert: the screen turns red with a flashing siren, AIR ALERT and the region's name, with a siren sound and a red blink of the status light; long or several names scroll by.
- When the alert ends: ALL CLEAR in green for a minute.
- Without a connection: the last known state, dimmed, with a red cross in the corner.

The app checks every 20 seconds. The BUSY Bar runs one app at a time, so alerts show only while this app is open.

## Data

[ubilling.net.ua aerial alerts](https://ubilling.net.ua/aerialalerts/) for Ukraine and [Tzeva Adom](https://www.tzevaadom.co.il) for Israel, no keys needed.
changelog: First release: regions of Ukraine and cities of Israel, a red screen with a siren sound and the status light during an alert, all clear for a minute.
